Hourly Capital Bikeshare rentals, 2011–2012

bike_hourly.Rd

Rental counts for casual and registered riders in the Capital Bikeshare system. Each row represents one recorded hour.

Usage

bike_hourly

Format

A data frame with 17,379 rows and 5 columns:

date

Calendar date of the observation.

hour

Hour of the day, from 0 (midnight) to 23 (11 pm).

day_type

Working day or non-working day. Non-working days include weekends and holidays.

casual

Number of rentals by casual riders during that hour.

registered

Number of rentals by registered riders during that hour.

Source

Hadi Fanaee-T, Bike Sharing dataset, UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5W894. Licensed under CC BY 4.0. This version retains five fields and labels the day types.
